Author: Mayo Botic, Ultranova Violet
Name: PF Analysis
Description: Manage your Party Finder recruitment and see who you are playing with. Save duty, objective, role and condition setups as presets and apply any of them in one click; watch your listing and party as it fills; and look up party members' progression and community ratings.
Punchline: Run your Party Finder: presets, party progression, and player lookups.
Changelog: Five Party Finder categories that could not be posted at all now can: Deep Dungeons, Treasure Hunt, FATEs, PvP and Duty Roulette. Each used to put a listing up with the wrong duty attached or with none, and three of them were offering names the game's own recruitment window has never had - deep dungeons were listed per floor set, treasure hunts as the dungeons a map opens into. They are listed the way the game lists them now, and a preset for one posts as that duty. Treasure hunts are also always limited to your own world, the way FATEs and hunt trains are, because the dig only happens on the world it was started on. Party Finder can also show you what a locked duty actually is, if you turn it on in Settings - listings the game labels "Locked Duty" get the fight's real name back, still marked so you can tell you cannot join. A prompt now dims and holds the whole plugin rather than one window, and the dimming behind it appears at all, which it never had.

Author: Mayo Botic
Name: DutyDM
Description: Get a Discord DM the instant your duty pops. Join the DutyDM Discord server, enter your Discord username, and the bot will message you the moment your queue is ready - with an in-game popup confirming it sent.
Punchline: Duty-pop alerts straight to your Discord DMs.
Changelog: Party-full alerts now only fire when the last seat fills while you wait (7 -> 8), and are blocked for 30 seconds after leaving a duty. Joining an already-full PF or re-forming after an instance no longer sends a redundant notification.

Author: Mayo Botic
Name: AutoRezzer
Description:
A quick, handy tool for handling raises - both casting them and accepting them.

REQUIRES Rotation Solver Reborn. Add the Combat Reborn repository first:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/CombatRebornRepo/main/pluginmaster.json

One switch, and it governs everything - off means nothing raises, nothing is accepted, and nothing is switched. While it is on, any raisable body in range gets raised on whatever job you are on that can do it, Swiftcast first when it is up, and Red Mage going through Vercure for an instant Verraise. Bodies with a raise already on them are left alone. The other half accepts raises cast on you, so you are not the one lying there waiting on a menu.

Pauses Rotation Solver Reborn for the length of a raise and puts it back the way it was - including Henched, which is what BOCCHI's Illegal Mode drives RSR with, so the two do not fight over targeting.

In Occult Crescent it uses the phantom job's own raise instead - Occult Raise on Phantom White Mage 4+, or Revive on Phantom Chemist 3+ - both instant, free and on a five second recast, and neither cares what job you are on, so a Warrior raises too. It can optionally borrow a raising phantom job out of combat and put yours back afterwards. Outside that it will not start a raise below 2400 MP, and below the floor it leaves your rotation alone rather than pausing it for nothing.

Built mostly for Occult Crescent and FATEs, where people go down constantly and nobody is tracking who still needs picking up.
Punchline: Raises everyone around you, and accepts your own. Built for Occult Crescent and FATEs.
Changelog:
Occult Crescent, Rotation Solver Reborn as a requirement, an MP floor, and a master switch.

REQUIRES Rotation Solver Reborn - add the Combat Reborn repository:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/CombatRebornRepo/main/pluginmaster.json

Occult Crescent: raises with the phantom job's own raise instead of everything else - Occult Raise on Phantom White Mage 4+, or Revive on Phantom Chemist 3+. Both are instant, cost no MP and recast in five seconds, and neither cares what job you are on, so a Warrior raises. Optionally borrows a raising phantom job out of combat and gives it back; off by default, with manual switch buttons for the one-off case.

BOCCHI: Illegal Mode drives RSR in Henched, and resuming in Auto used to hand RSR its own targeting back mid-run without BOCCHI noticing. Resume mode now defaults to Henched when BOCCHI is loaded. AutoRezzer never touches BOCCHI itself.

Minimum MP (2400-10000): below the floor the plugin leaves your rotation alone rather than pausing it for a raise that was never going to happen. Red Mage's Vercure adds 500 on top.

Also: only-rez-with-Swiftcast, optionally in combat only; out-of-combat Red Mage switch for an instant Verraise; permanent statistics on their own tab; a status line that describes the room; announcements moved to echo; enemy distance and raise delay now default to 0.

Enabled is now a master switch - off means nothing raises and nothing is accepted.

Fixes: RSR received every mode change twice; RSR was reported active whenever its command merely existed; turning the plugin off mid-swap left you in the healer's gearset.
